basic_details.job_title: CSIR NEERI Project Associate II Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.organization_name: CSIR National Environmental Engineering Research Institute
basic_details.short_information: CSIR National Environmental Engineering Research Institute has released the official Project Associate II Notification 2026 at https://www.neeri.res.in/. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under the CSIR NEERI Project Associate II Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates up to 35 years of age with M.Sc. in Microbiology/Biotechnology, B.Tech/B.E. in Biotechnology with 2 years of R&D experience, or M.Tech/M.E. in Biotechnology can apply online up to 31 July 2026. The official notification PDF and online application link are available below.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years. Age relaxation rules will be as per government norms.

qualification.education_qualification: M.Sc. in Microbiology/ Biotechnology, B.Tech/ B.E. in Biotechnology with 2 years R&D experience, M.Tech/ M.E. in Biotechnology
qualification.details: M.Sc. in Microbiology/ Biotechnology OR B.Tech/ B.E. in Biotechnology with 2 years experience in R&D Work OR M.Tech/ M.E. in Biotechnology from a recognized University.

salary_details.details: Rs. 28,000/- + HRA or Rs. 35,000/- + HRA Per Month

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-07-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR NEERI to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment is 31st July 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess an M.Sc. in Microbiology/Biotechnology, or a B.Tech/B.E. in Biotechnology with 2 years of R&D experience, or an M.Tech/M.E. in Biotechnology from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 28,000/- + HRA to Rs. 35,000/- + HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-II post at CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-II position will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR NEERI is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 440020.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual position. The recruitment is for Project Associate-II posts on a contractual basis.
